description: Circadian Dice is a game inspired by single-player deck-building games, but instead of upgrading a deck, you build up a set of dice! Use 10 different heroes and 60 game-warping relics to take on 13 hand-crafted scenarios, in runs that take 10-30 minutes. Lots of secrets and unlocks to discover!
name: Circadian Dice

objectives.co_op_rules: Flip primary objectives equal to the # of players, everyone must complete a primary objective with the flipped secondary objective
objectives.versus_tertiary: Most money at end of run

entries.text: As long as you have rerolls left, you must reroll
Only buy and install upgrades on your first die
